name: Left-aligned statement hero
visual_test: Headline (and maybe one paragraph/CTA) set flush-left on a plain or single-colour field; any media sits below or is absent; no hard 50/50 divide
search_phrase: large left-aligned headline on a plain background
aliases: flush-left hero; left-aligned hero; statement hero; text-only hero
examples: planhat, lunit, overture, moheim, unfold, elucidate
notes: The left-aligned twin of 01 Centred hero. Dominant in fintech/healthcare/SaaS/agency. Search drifts to 26 Monumental type after ~rank 12. Absorbs "Two-column text split" (groth, functionhealth, twingate: 3 in sample, 6/10, 8/30 with "huge headline on the left and a paragraph column on the right, no images").

name: Text-left / visual-right hero
visual_test: One continuous field: headline + CTA block on the left, illustration/photo/product cluster on the right with no hard panel edge
search_phrase: headline and buttons on the left, illustration on the right, white background
aliases: asymmetric hero; two-column hero; 60/40 hero; soft split
class: CORE — add, or formal soft variant of 07 Split screen
examples: intuit, element, medium, color, backbase, gusto
notes: First phrase "headline on the left, photo on the right" scored only 4/10, 5/30 — "photo" pulls hard 07 split screens. Saying "illustration" + "buttons" + "white background" isolates the SaaS form.

name: Logo splash
visual_test: Only a logo/wordmark (maybe a tiny tagline) centred on an otherwise empty screen
search_phrase: only a small logo centred on a blank screen
class: NICHE — add but score loaders as misses
examples: humanmade, dovetail, tuxkarma, bindery, dorianeazzouz, sanserif
notes: Visually indistinguishable from preloaders; 4–6 of top 30 are half-loaded. Keep separate from 30 Isolated object (that is a product/photo object).

name: Motif field
visual_test: A repeating pattern, tile or texture fills the whole background; content sits on top of it
search_phrase: repeating pattern of shapes filling the whole background
aliases: pattern field; wallpaper hero; tiled pattern background; texture field
examples: globalmaritimeforum, profectum, tote, projektilart, hellokuya, akiracine
notes: Mostly appears as a background modifier on 01 Centred hero (heyjay, superhi, collastudio) — could be a modifier, but searches find it reliably so it works as a category.

name: Letter scatter
visual_test: The letters (or words) of a wordmark are spaced far apart / scattered across the whole screen
search_phrase: letters of a word scattered far apart across the page
aliases: scattered type; exploded wordmark; spaced-out letters
examples: coevalstudio, analoguefoundation, hervebaillargeon, dondregreen, matbold, franc
notes: Rare in sample but search is precise in top 10.

name: Bleed photo overprint
visual_test: A giant wordmark/headline overlaps or is printed across a full-bleed (or large) photo
search_phrase: giant wordmark overlapping a full-bleed photo
aliases: type over image; wordmark overprint; knockout type
class: MODIFIER — of 02 Full-bleed and 26 Monumental type
examples: loftgarten, thekelsey, sunny-futures, goodside, rocketweblabs, ever-live-here
notes: Search returns mostly plain 26 Monumental type; better as an attribute than a category.

name: Framed media on empty stage
visual_test: One small framed photo/video sits in a large empty field, like a print on a gallery wall
search_phrase: one small framed photo centred on an empty background
aliases: gallery stage; floating frame; matted image
class: WEAK — merge into 30 Isolated object in void (object = framed image)
examples: kinfolk, thefamilyreviews, hueylightshop, grapheine, marieguillaume, joshuaoladiti
notes: Search mixes in half-loaded blanks and text-only screens.

name: Shape-mask window
visual_test: Photo cropped inside a non-rectangular shape (arch, circle, blob, notched panel)
search_phrase: photo cropped inside an arch shape
aliases: arch mask; circle crop; shaped image window
class: MODIFIER — image-crop attribute, not a layout
examples: betterinvest, digivalet, nueve, rekorderstudios, lenkadaviesova, caramia
notes: arch routes to architecture photos (real arches). Treat as attribute.
